original.statement: Route53 DNS01 solver now correctly detects not-found errors when deleting DNS records (bugfix).

decision.reason: [ev-23e99dfde8d0] says cert-manager 1.18.0 fixes how AWS Route53 not-found errors are detected when DNS records are deleted. The configuration stays the same and only the runtime semantics change, so behavior-changed is the right type. protocol-behavior is the right family for this runtime-only interaction. The name "route53-not-found-error-detection" is a short kebab-case name built from the evidence's own words.
